explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/504 and the docstring's reference to Theorem 1 of [ErSz60]: every set of 2^n points in the plane determines an angle strictly greater than π(1−1/n). The statement asks for p, q, r ∈ S with p ≠ q, r ≠ q and the angle at q exceeding (1−1/n)π; p ≠ r is not required but p = r gives angle 0, so it is implied. A Lean proof is linked. Faithful.
